HELPER-API-CURRENT.txt: Optional helper, pure JDK: org.lightyear.cobol.RecordNumbers. May use the provided helper for numeric record encoding. Ordinary Java is permitted. Current merged slice 1A only: Pic.parse; Descriptor(Pic, Usage, Sign); Arena(capacity), load, length, snapshot, replace, view; Field.read/isNumeric/writeExact; encodeExact/decode/numericClass. Number stores BigInteger coefficient, scale and negativeZero. Usage DISPLAY/PACKED/BINARY; Sign UNSIGNED/TRAILING/LEADING/TRAILING_SEPARATE/LEADING_SEPARATE. writeExact refuses rounding or precision loss. Fields use byte-backed storage. NUMPROC NOPFD, cp037; conservative unsigned sign and nonzero pad restrictions apply. This helper is not used by the judge or reference. Decimal arithmetic, layout auditor and MOVE helpers are not implemented here. No claim of their availability. See the separately reviewed slice 1A profile before admission.
JAVA-IO-CONTRACT.txt:
PROPOSED interface; requires exact review before implementation.
Java 21, default-package Main; pure JDK only. Candidate source files confined to candidate/intcalc/src/. The trusted wrapper supplies the compiler and launches Main with these required arguments: --input-dir DIR --output-dir DIR --processing-date YYYYMMDDHH --timestamp YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.ffffff --codec cp037. No implicit wall-clock date, network, environment-provided behavior or subprocesses.
Inputs are immutable headerless fixed records without RDW/BDW/newlines: ACCTFILE.bin LRECL300; TCATBALF.bin LRECL50; DISCGRP.bin LRECL50; XREFFILE.bin LRECL50. Original copybooks define numeric representation, keys and fields; the layout file names source DDs including unused JCL aliases. Preserve sorted indexed traversal and keyed random lookups required by the COBOL source. Outputs are ACCTFILE.bin and TRANSACT.bin LRECL350 in a distinct empty output directory; do not modify input files. Retain untouched account bytes and defined filler/timestamp bytes. Implement explicit source error exits and report errors to stderr; do not invent successful output after a failure. CEE3ABD maps to a failing candidate exit with a diagnostic; this is not LE or JES emulation.
Trusted build command shape: javac --release 21 -d CLASSES @SOURCES.argfile (argfile made by trusted sorted inventory, not the model). Trusted run command shape: java -cp CLASSES Main --input-dir INPUT --output-dir OUTPUT --processing-date DATE --timestamp TIMESTAMP --codec cp037.
